name: Gargantuan Tumor
summary: The Gargantuan Tumor is a massive, diseased growth torn from the corrupted timberling Oakenscowl in Teldrassil. It serves as glaring proof of the unnatural sickness spreading through the creatures inhabiting Lake Al'Ameth.

sections.title: Blight Upon the Lake
sections.body: Near the southern bank of Lake Al'Ameth, a cavern shelters Oakenscowl, once a noble timberling elder who has fallen prey to vile affliction. The creature was visibly poisoned by an enormous growth that warped its behavior and seeped taint into surrounding wildlife. Severing this grotesque tumor is crucial not only to end the beast's tormented rampage, but to allow local researchers to inspect the blight and understand how such a foul malady took root in the boughs of the newly grown World Tree.

faq.q: Where does the Gargantuan Tumor come from?
faq.answer: The tumor is retrieved from Oakenscowl, a large corrupted timberling residing in a cave on the southern shore of Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is causing the tumor to grow on Oakenscowl?
aliases: why does oakenscowl have a tumor
faq.answer: It is an outward symptom of the strange corruption poisoning the timberlings and wildlife around Lake Al'Ameth. Oakenscowl was once a grand leader of his kind, but succumbed entirely to this virulent growth.

faq.q: Who wants to study this tumor?
faq.answer: Investigators in the area require the tumor to research the strange rot afflicting local timberlings, hoping to discern how to treat or halt the blight.

angles.text: For druids striving to nurture the fledgling boughs of Teldrassil, the grotesque tumor is an alarming reminder that nature within the boughs is dangerously vulnerable to corruption.
Seeing a respected elder timberling reduced to a mad, blighted monster underscores the growing environmental troubles facing the kaldorei's new homeland.
